# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome young lady with a plump, showy figure, a brilliant complexion, and large, bright-blue eyes. She has a long yellow braid and flowing hair, which she tries to do up in town. She wears her skirts as long as her mother permits and laughs a great deal.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and frankly enjoys the pleasant things in life. She is inclined to be hysterical and often bursts into tears when startled or overwhelmed. She is sentimental and becomes heavily preoccupied with young men and romance as she grows older.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

- cheerful  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- good-tempered  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- sentimental  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- to have a beau as soon as she is fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to have many suitors when she grows up  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- to teach for two years after studying at Queen's and then get married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Ruby attends Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her classmates. On Anne's first day of school, Ruby gives her an apple. Gilbert Blythe pins Ruby's long yellow braid to her seat, causing her to fall back and cry when she stands up. She takes part in school activities, such as climbing a willow tree on a dare despite her fear of caterpillars, preparing a dialogue titled 'A Morning Visit', joining a story club, and performing in a concert tableau draped in white. As she enters her teens, she joins the Queen's preparation class intending to become a teacher for two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_
